parent.f106_negative: D106-B inverted-mode 577/577 teacher labels neutral; D106-A 36 negative, 359 zero, 62 positive. Feature aliasing replicated only normal-mode; F105 20F learned did not beat F60. No prior GUARD/DIAGNOSTIC used for selection.

question: In genuinely paired newly constructed graphs, does role inversion destroy source answer information, structural teacher contrast, native F60 memory equivariance, or the frozen label definition itself? Compare raw, role-only, edge-direction-only and both transformations under identical node IDs, event arrival order and terminal source path.

source.construction: Call unchanged F102.episode(native, seed, family, 'raw', namespace) ONLY for new public negative-seed identities. From EXACT same raw graph and query, derive four purely bijective transformations: raw; role_only with role permutation (2,0,3,1) applied to all edges and query ops; edge_direction_only by reversing every public edge and flipping every query op sign; both using both changes. Preserve node IDs, source graph edge arrival ordering, query start, answer, length and source identity pairing. No stochastic rebuild for transformed pair.
source.native_fixed_controller: Real F62->F60 native _f60_step, actions, _finish_fixed, codec; 12 native packed records 144 bytes; no learner fitted or tuned.
source.source_oracle: F104 signed source_path on each full transformed public graph; verify role/direction bijection, exact start/terminal answer and full 4/6/8 path persists. This oracle is ONLY offline, no privileged first-use or online input.
source.signed_memory_semantics: Compare normalized F60 native memory arcs under transformation, and query-blind F99 six-hop closure only where safe, to determine whether numeric signed-role transform preserves native candidate behavior. Differences do not automatically imply software bug, since F60 tie breaking might intentionally be role-dependent.
source.credit_teacher: At each checkpoint and each F60-legal action compute frozen F105 eight-event continuation via F60 _finish_fixed, exact F104 source path subspans (<=6 signed roles), terminal retained overlap credit relative to the local F60 action. Independently compute zero-lookahead direct structural potential before suffix and record both sign histograms. Future query, labels, source identity absent from online F60.
source.cause_comparison: Check split-role-only and direction-only separately against both and raw, and whether the direct structural labels have nonzero sign but eight-event continuation collapses them to zero. Report whether the transformed path is answer-reachable with all original public edges, whether native F60 retains at least one relevant segment and whether structural potential survives sign inversion.
source.no_prior_sources: Do not regenerate or inspect F102–F106 GUARD/DIAGNOSTIC episodes or original F62 FIT/DIAG/ORIGINAL.

frozen_analysis.source_information_lost_if: Any paired transformed source cannot reconstruct EXACT terminal answer path on full public graph, despite bijection. Treat as source transformation/provenance invalid, fail run rather than interpret signal loss.
frozen_analysis.teacher_collapse: If any mode has zero non-neutral eight-event labels across all new paired episodes, report TEACHER_SIGNAL_COLLAPSE_MODE_<mode>. Do not claim all source information missing.
frozen_analysis.source_native_symmetry: Report per-case exact normalized native F60 arc-set equivariance compared to raw; native F60 not invariant is not by itself proof of a direction encoding software defect or an intelligence limit.
frozen_analysis.direct_vs_continuation: If direct native candidate structural label has non-neutral contrast and identical 8-event continuation has zero contrast, classify LOSS_IN_CONTINUATION_CONTROL (descriptive only). If both zero despite valid full source path, classify NO_LOCAL_STRUCTURAL_CREDIT; this may be due to fixed 144B online retention and action set.
frozen_analysis.true_label_scope: F104/F105 structural potential is a proxy for downstream retention, not terminal hidden answer probability, not a causal learning generalization proof.
frozen_analysis.no_hindsight: Do not modify transformations, teacher, source IDs, positive definition or mode lists after report; bug fixes must retain prereg, original failed history and exact changed source hashes.
